heroImage.alt: A handcrafted antler flute with both curved antler ends visible, resting on the forest floor

statements: No animals were ever, or will ever be harmed in the making of these flutes and jewelry.
Every year all Elk on Planet Earth naturally shed their Antlers. Hansen ONLY uses these Wild Shed Antlers. He uses vintage shells for harps and other instruments, usually they are several decades old
All other animal products used are Fossils that are Tens of Thousands of years old.
All materials are treated with greatest respect and honor
